admission.justification: Claiming a draw-time wait without a draw signal falsely promises behavior the older plugin cannot report.

applicability: Waiting notice for the older plugin lacking displayed-conversation confirmation.
conditions: The older plugin can open agents and replies when its agent screen is opened.
The application own progress mark remains visible until drawing.
exclusions: The current drawing-capable plugin keeps the dashboard line until drawing or its native failure report.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx › "is named with the provisioning command and still switches by message when it says nothing about itself"; the older plug-in under load: notes/reports/worker/c41a5d77-92e0-4b18-a3d6-140c0a7e0b50/the-pane-before-and-after-attempt3/after-older-plug-in-under-load.png (walk A1 of Attempt3)

statement: With the plug-in of 2026-10-08 the dashboard's waiting line ends at that plug-in's answer, which comes when the agent's screen is opened and not when the conversation is drawn; the frame's notice says so.
